name: skillarray
description: Evidence-grounded Claude Code skills for multi-model review, cross-vendor verification, and shared engineering knowledge.

plugins.name: pair-review
plugins.description: Two distinct models from one vendor review the same code, design or document blind, exchange their findings, and a fresh auditor settles each one: execution-gated, identity-blinded, evidence-graded.

plugins.name: cross-review
plugins.description: Two reviewers from different vendors review the same code, design or document blind, cross-examine each other's findings, and a fresh auditor settles each one: execution-gated, identity-blinded, refutation-asymmetric.

plugins.name: shared-brain
plugins.description: A shared, cross-project engineering knowledge store: search, capture, and migrate durable lessons via an MCP backend. Separate opt-in plugin, not installed automatically with the review skills.
